safi-cedvel:49-51.t:
* I'rab:
(لا) negative particle. (من دعاء) attached to (يسأم). (الواو) conjunction. (مسّه) a past verb in the position of the jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). (الفاء) connects the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). (يئوس) khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being "هو" (he). (قنوط) a second khabar, nominative; it is for emphasis (tawkīd).
The clause «لا يسأم الإنسان ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya).
The clause «مسّه الشّر ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause «لا يسأم». The clause «(هو) يئوس ... » is in the position of the jussive, the apodosis, joined by the فاء.
50- (الواو) is a conjunction in the four places. (اللام) is the lām that prepares for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa lil-qasam). (إن) a particle of jussive conditional. (أذقناه) like (مسّه). (منّا) attached to an adjective (naʿt) of (رحمة). (من بعد) attached to (أذقناه). (اللام) the lām of the oath. (يقولّن) an imperfect verb indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative, and (النون) is the nūn of emphasis; the agent (fāʿil) is "he" (latent). (لي) attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هذا). (ما) negative. (لئن) like the first. (التاء) in (رجعت) is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) [Translator's note: the source says nāʾib al-fāʿil here, although (رجعت) is active, so the تاء is the fāʿil], and it is like (مسّه). (إلى ربّي) attached to (رجعت). (لي) attached to the fronted khabar of inna. (عنده) an accusative adverbial (ẓarf) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (الحسنى). (اللام) the lām of the oath. (الحسنى) ism (subject) of inna, accusative, the sign of the accusative being an implied fatḥa. (الفاء) connects the apodosis of an implied condition. (اللام) the lām of the oath, for an implied oath. (ننبّئنّ) like (يقولّن). (ما) a maṣdar particle
, and the interpreted maṣdar (ما عملوا ... ) is in the position of the genitive, attached to (ننبّئنّ). [Translator's note: the source text has a stray closing quotation mark after «حرف مصدري» and a line break at this point; it is kept as it stands.]
(لنذيقنّهم) like (لننبّئنّ). (من عذاب) attached to (نذيقنّهم). The clause «أذقناه ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause «مسّه الشرّ». The clause «مسّته ... » is in the position of the genitive, an adjective (naʿt) of (ضرّاء). The clause «يقولّن ... » has no grammatical position; it is the response to the oath ... and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.
The clause «هذا لي ... » is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «ما أظنّ الساعة قائمة» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause of the content of the saying. The clause «رجعت ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause «أذقناه».
The clause «إنّ لي عنده للحسنى» has no grammatical position; it is the response to the oath, and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.
The clause «ننبّئنّ ... » has no grammatical position; it is the response to the implied oath. The implied oath clause is the apodosis of an implied condition, that is: "if the Hour comes to pass, We shall surely inform those who disbelieved ...".
The clause «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذين). The clause «عملوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the particle-relative (ما) (al-mawṣūl al-ḥarfī). The clause «لنذيقنّهم ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause «لننبّئنّ ...».
51- (الواو) is a conjunction in both places. (على الإنسان) attached to (أنعمنا). (بجانبه) attached to (نأى), and (الباء) is for transitivity (taʿdiya). (إذا مسّه الشرّ فذو..) is like «إن مسّه الشرّ فيئوس».
The clause «أنعمنا ... » is in the position of the genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive complement).
The clause «أعرض ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition. The clause «نأى ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause «أعرض». The clause «مسّه الشرّ ... » is in the position of the genitive, a muḍāf ilayhi. The clause «(هو) ذو ... » has no grammatical position; it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.

* Morphology:
(قنوط): an intensive form (ṣīghat mubālagha) of the active participle of the triliteral verb قنط; its wazn is فعول with fatḥa on the فاء.
(نأى): it has an ʿilāl (weakening) by substitution; its origin is نأي, with a ياء at the end; its maṣdar is النأي. The ياء was vowelled after a fatḥa and was changed into an alif. (عريض): a muśabbaha adjective (ṣifa mushabbaha, assimilated adjective) from the triliteral عرض, of the pattern (bāb) كرم; its wazn is فعيل.

* Rhetoric:
The makniyya takhyīliyya metaphor (istiʿāra makniyya takhyīliyya, an implicit, imaginative metaphor): in the saying of the Exalted «فَذُو دُعاءٍ عَرِيضٍ».
«عريض» means: abundant and continuous, borrowed from what has wide breadth. Its origin is from what bodies are described by; it is the shorter of the two extensions, and by convention "broad" is understood as spaciousness. The intensive form and the tanwīn of multiplicity strengthen this. Naturally, the metaphor of breadth is more eloquent than the metaphor of length, because if its breadth is such, what do you think of its length? Here supplication is likened to something described as having extension, and then breadth is affirmed for it.

* Benefits:
- Omission of the mubtadaʾ..
1- The omission of the mubtadaʾ is frequent in the answer to a question, as in the saying of the Exalted: «وَما أَدْراكَ مَا الْحُطَمَةُ؟ نارُ اللَّهِ الْمُوقَدَةُ» that is, "it is the Fire of Allah"; «وَأَصْحابُ الْيَمِينِ ما أَصْحابُ الْيَمِينِ؟ فِي سِدْرٍ مَخْضُودٍ» that is, "they are among thornless lote trees".
2- After the fāʾ of the apodosis, as in the saying of the Exalted: «مَنْ عَمِلَ صالِحاً فَلِنَفْسِهِ وَمَنْ أَساءَ فَعَلَيْها» that is, "his deed is for himself and his wrongdoing is against himself". Likewise in the verse we are now treating: «وَإِنْ مَسَّهُ الشَّرُّ فَيَؤُسٌ قَنُوطٌ» that is, "then he is despairing, hopeless".
3- After the saying (al-qawl), as in the saying of the Exalted: «قالُوا: أَساطِيرُ الْأَوَّلِينَ» that is:
"they are tales of the ancients".
4- After a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is, in meaning, an adjective of it, as in the saying of the Exalted: «التَّائِبُونَ الْعابِدُونَ» that is, "they are the repentant". So (التائبون) is the khabar of the omitted mubtadaʾ (هم) in terms of i'rab, whereas in meaning it is an adjective of it. Likewise «صُمٌّ بُكْمٌ عُمْيٌ» that is, "they are deaf".
5- It has also occurred elsewhere, as in the saying of the Exalted: «لا يَغُرَّنَّكَ تَقَلُّبُ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا فِي الْبِلادِ مَتاعٌ قَلِيلٌ» that is, "their moving about is a little enjoyment"; and «لم يلبثوا إلا ساعة من نهار بلاغ» that is, "this is a message"; and «سُورَةٌ أَنْزَلْناها» that is, "this is a sūra which We have sent down".

safi-cedvel:52-52.t:
* I'rab:
(أرأيتم) means "tell me"; the first object is omitted, its implied form being "أنفسكم" (yourselves). (كان) an incomplete past verb (kāna), in the position of the jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); its ism is a latent pronoun referring to the Qur'an, understood from the context. (من عند) attached to the khabar of kāna. (به) attached to (كفرتم). (من) an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, its khabar being (أضلّ). (ممّن) attached to (أضلّ). (في شقاق) attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هو).
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «أرأيتم ... » is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl). The clause «إن كان من عند ... » has no grammatical position; it is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). The apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by the nominal clause after it, that is: "then you are the most astray" or "then no one is more astray than you". The clause «كفرتم به ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause «كان».
The clause «من أضلّ ... » is in the position of the accusative, the second direct object, whose governor is (أرأيتم). The clause «هو في شقاق ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (من).

safi-cedvel:53-53.t:
* I'rab:
(في الآفاق) attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of (آياتنا), and likewise (في أنفسهم), which is conjoined to the first. (حتّى) a particle of limit and genitive. (يتبيّن) an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after حتّى. (لهم) attached to (يتبيّن)..
The interpreted maṣdar (أن يتبيّن..) is in the position of the genitive by (حتّى), attached to (نريهم). The interpreted maṣdar (أنّه الحقّ..) is in the position of the nominative, the fāʿil (agent) of (يتبيّن). (الهمزة) is for affirmative interrogation (istifhām taqrīrī). (الواو) conjunction. (ربّك) genitive in form by the باء, accusative in position, the object of (يكف). [Note: It is possible that it is the agent, nominative in position, with the interpreted maṣdar after it a substitute (badal) of it, or in the position of the genitive by an omitted باء, that is: "Does your Lord not suffice them, in that He is witness over everything".] (على كلّ) attached to (شهيد), the khabar of أنّ.
The interpreted maṣdar (أنّه على كلّ شيء شهيد) is in the position of the nominative, the fāʿil of (يكفى). The clause «سنريهم ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive. The clause «يتبيّن ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the implied particle-relative (أن).
The clause «يكف بربّك ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to an implied clause, that is: "Does your Lord not suffice them and avail them, in that ...".

safi-cedvel:54-54.t:
* I'rab:
(ألا) a particle of alerting. (في مرية) attached to the khabar of inna. (من لقاء) attached to (مرية). (ألا) like the first. (بكلّ) attached to (محيط).
The clause «إنّهم في مرية ... » has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.
The clause «إنّه بكلّ شيء محيط» has no grammatical position; it is resumptive.

* Morphology:
(53) (الآفاق): plural of (الأفق), meaning a region; its wazn is فعل with two ḍammas. The madda in (الآفاق) was originally two hamzas, the first with fatḥa and the second with sukūn, on the wazn أفعال, that is أأفاق..
(يكف): ʿilāl by deletion, for the sake of conformity with the jussive; it is a defective verb (muʿtall nāqiṣ), jussive after (لم); its wazn is يفع.

safi-cedvel:13-18.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) conjunction, and the second [فاء] is the connective (rābiṭa) (أعرضوا) in the position of the jussive, protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) (صاعقة) second direct object (mafʿūl bihi), accusative (مثل) adjective (naʿt) of صاعقة, accusative.
Clause: «أعرضوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قل [Note: in verse (9) of this sūra.] .
And the clause: «قل ... » is in the position of the jussive, apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) joined with the فاء.
And the clause: «أنذرتكم ... » is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying (maqūl al-qawl).
(14) (إذ) adverbial in the position of the accusative, attached to صاعقة عاد because it has the meaning of "punishment" [Note: or attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of صاعقة عاد.] , (من بين) attached to a ḥāl of الرسل, and likewise (من خلفهم) , (أن) is the lightened form of the heavy [أنّ] [Note: and in that case it is written separately from (لا) ; it is also permissible that it be a particle of explanation, because the coming of the messengers preceded it and it contains the meaning of saying, with (لا) a prohibitive, and the clause having no grammatical position; and it is permissible that it be a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative, with (لا) a negative, and the interpreted maṣdar in the position of the genitive by an implied (الباء).] , and its subject (ism) is an omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn); (لا) prohibitive (إلّا) for restriction (الله) the divine name, direct object, accusative (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of (لو) (الفاء) conjunction, to link the effect with the cause (بما) attached to the predicate كافرون (به) attached to (أرسلتم) , and the pronoun of address in it is the deputy agent (nāʾib al-fāʿil).
And the clause: «جاءتهم الرسل ... » is in the position of the genitive, as muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «تعبدوا ... » is in the position of the nominative, predicate (khabar) of the lightened (أن) .
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن لا تعبدوا..) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted (باء) .. attached to (جاءتهم) .
And the clause: «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption (istiʾnāf bayānī).
And the clause: «لو شاء الله ... » is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause: «أنزل ... » has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «إنّا ... كافرون» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause لو شاء..
And the clause: «أرسلتم به ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما) .
(15) (الفاء) conjunction of consequence (tafrīʿiyya) (أمّا) a particle of condition and elaboration (عاد) mubtadaʾ (subject), nominative (الفاء) connective for the apodosis of أمّا (في الأرض) attached to (استكبروا) , (بغير) ḥāl from the agent of استكبروا (الواو) conjunction in the three places (من) interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, its khabar being أشدّ (منّا) attached to أشدّ (قوّة) tamyīz (specification), accusative (الهمزة) for rebuking interrogation (الذي) relative noun in the position of the accusative, adjective (naʿt) of the divine name (هو) separation pronoun (ḍamīr faṣl) [Note: or a detached pronoun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is أشدّ, and the nominal clause is the khabar of إنّ.] , (منهم قوّة) like منّا قوّة ... (بآياتنا) attached to (يجحدون) .
And the interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله ... ) is in the position of the accusative, filling the place of the two objects of يروا.
And the clause: «أمّا عاد ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أعرضوا [Note: or it is resumptive, in the context of consequence.] .
And the clause: «استكبروا ... » is in the position of the nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ عاد.
And the clause: «قالوا ... » is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause استكبروا.
And the clause: «من أشدّ ... » is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause: «لم يروا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to an implied resumption within the scope of the saying, that is: "Were they heedless and did they not see ..."
And the clause: «خلقهم ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي) .
And the clause: «كانوا ... يجحدون» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause استكبروا.
And the clause: «يجحدون ... » is in the position of the accusative, khabar of كانوا.
(16) (الفاء) conjunction (عليهم) attached to (أرسلنا) , (في أيّام) attached to (أرسلنا) , (اللام) for giving a reason (نذيقهم) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the لام (عذاب) second direct object, accusative (في الحياة) attached to (نذيقهم) ...
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن نذيقهم ... ) is in the position of the genitive by the لام, attached to (أرسلنا) .
(الواو) parenthetical (اعتراضيّة) (اللام) the lām of commencement (lām al-ibtidāʾ), for emphasis (الواو) conjunction - or circumstantial (ḥāliyya) - (لا) negative, and the (الواو) in (ينصرون) is the deputy agent.
And the clause: «أرسلنا ... » is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause كانوا ...
And the clause: «نذيقهم ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the implied particle (أن) .
And the clause: «عذاب الآخرة أخزى ... » has no grammatical position, parenthetical.
And the clause: «هم لا ينصرون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause عذاب الآخرة.... [Note: it is permissible that it be in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the third-person pronoun in (نذيقهم) .]
And the clause: «لا ينصرون» is in the position of the nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم) .
(17-18) (الواو) conjunction (أما ثمود) like أمّا عاد (الفاء) connective for the apodosis of (أمّا) , and the second is a conjunction (على الهدى) attached to the verb (استحبّوا) by its being made to include the meaning "they chose" (الفاء) conjunction (الهون) adjective (naʿt) of (العذاب) , genitive (بما) attached to (أخذتهم) [Note: it is a maṣdar-forming particle interpreted with what follows as a maṣdar, or a relative noun with the returning pronoun omitted.] .
And the clause: «أمّا ثمود فهديناهم ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause أمّا عاد ...
And the clause: «هديناهم ... » is in the position of the nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ثمود) .
And the clause: «استحبّوا ... » is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause هديناهم.
And the clause: «أخذتهم صاعقة..» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause استحبّوا.
And the clause: «كانوا يكسبون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle or relative noun (ما) .
And the clause: «يكسبون» is in the position of the accusative, khabar of كانوا.
And the clause: «نجّينا..» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause أخذتهم ...
And the clause: «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «كانوا يتّقون..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause آمنوا [Note: or in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the relative noun, with an implied (قد) , or a ḥāl from the agent of آمنوا, also with an implied (قد) ..] .
And the clause: «يتّقون ... » is in the position of the accusative, khabar of كانوا.

* Morphology:
(16) صرصرا: a name for the violent wind, or a derived adjective from الصرّ, which is the cold, or from the triliteral صرّ (of the pattern ضرب) in the sense of "it made a sound and cried out violently"; its wazn is فعلل, with fatḥa on the fāʾ and on the first lām.
(نحسات) , plural of نحس, a derived adjective from the triliteral نحس (of the pattern فرح); its wazn is فعل (fatḥa then kasra) like أشر.
(أخزى) , an elative (ism tafḍīl) from the triliteral خزي (of the pattern فرح); its wazn is أفعل, and it contains a weakening (iʿlāl) by substitution: its origin is أخزي - with yāʾ - the yāʾ had a vowel and what precedes it had a fatḥa, so it was changed to alif.
(17) العمى: a maṣdar of عمي يعمى (of the pattern فرح); its wazn is فعل (fatḥa then sukūn), and it contains a weakening by substitution: its origin is العمي - with yāʾ - the yāʾ came vowelled after a fatḥa and was changed to alif.. and it was written in the form of an undotted yāʾ because of its origin.

* Rhetoric:
1- Iltifāt (shift of person): in the saying of the Exalted «فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا» .
He first addressed them with his saying: «أإنكم» , but they paid no heed to his address and did not take in his advice, so he shifted from address to the third person, because they had carried out the turning away, so he could do nothing but turn away from addressing them, so that harmony is sound and the wording suits the meaning; and this is among the loftiest and most refined kinds of eloquence. How many secrets iltifāt has!
2- Shifting from the future imperfect to the past: in the saying of the Exalted «فَقُلْ أَنْذَرْتُكُمْ» .
The past form indicates the certainty of the warning, which tells of the certainty of what was warned of.
3- Figurative attribution (isnād majāzī): in the saying of the Exalted «وَلَعَذابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَخْزى» .
Punishment ("ʿadhāb") is originally an attribute of the one punished, but the punishment itself was described by it through figurative attribution for the sake of exaggeration, for it indicates that the disgrace of the disbeliever increased so much that his punishment became characterized by it, as was established in their saying: شعر شاعر (a poet's poetry).
4- Mushākala (conformity of expression): in the saying of the Exalted «وَلَعَذابُ الْآخِرَةِ أَخْزى ... » .
He made disgrace a predicate this time, for the sake of conformity, along the lines of the poet's saying:
«قلت اطبخوا لي جبة وقميصا» (I said: cook me a jubba and a shirt)

5- Explicit metaphor (istiʿāra taṣrīḥiyya): in the saying of the Exalted «فَاسْتَحَبُّوا الْعَمى عَلَى الْهُدى» .
He likened disbelief to blindness, because the disbeliever is astray from the goal, wandering off the road like the blind man, and he likened faith to guidance, because the believer is guided to the goal and the level path; then he omitted the thing likened in both and kept the thing likened to.

* Benefits:
- What separates أما from the فاء:
1- The mubtadaʾ: as in the saying of the Exalted فَأَمَّا الَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ ما تَشابَهَ مِنْهُ ابْتِغاءَ الْفِتْنَةِ وَابْتِغاءَ تَأْوِيلِهِ.
2- The khabar: as in our saying (أما في الدار فزيد) .
3- The conditional clause: as in the saying of the Exalted فَأَمَّا إِنْ كانَ مِنَ الْمُقَرَّبِينَ فَرَوْحٌ وَرَيْحانٌ وَجَنَّةُ نَعِيمٍ.
4- A noun accusative, in form or in position, by the apodosis: as in the saying of the Exalted فَأَمَّا الْيَتِيمَ فَلا تَقْهَرْ 5- A noun governed by an omitted verb which what follows the فاء explains, such as (أما زيدا فاضربه) . And the reading of some in the verse we are dealing with وَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَهَدَيْناهُمْ فَاسْتَحَبُّوا الْعَمى عَلَى الْهُدى is with the accusative, and the governing verb must be implied after the فاء.

safi-cedvel:19-25.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (يوم) direct object of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر (إلى النار) attached to (يحشر) , (الفاء) conjunction, and the (الواو) in (يوزعون) is the deputy agent.
Clause: « (اذكر) يوم ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «يحشر أعداء ... » is in the position of the genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «هم يوزعون ... » is in the position of the genitive, conjoined to the clause يحشر أعداء.
And the clause: «يوزعون ... » is in the position of the nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم) .
(20) (حتّى) particle of commencement (ما) redundant (zāʾida) (عليهم) attached to (شهد) , (بما) attached to (شهد) [Note: (ما) is a maṣdar-forming particle, and the interpreted maṣdar is in the position of the genitive, or a relative noun with the returning pronoun omitted.] , and the (الباء) denotes cause.
And the clause: «جاءوها ... » is in the position of the genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «شهد ... سمعهم» has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «كانوا يعملون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle or relative noun (ما) .
And the clause: «يعملون» is in the position of the accusative, khabar of كانوا.
(21) (الواو) conjunction in the three places (لجلودهم) attached to (قالوا) , (لم) attached to (شهدتم) [Note: (ما) is an interrogative noun from which the alif was dropped because the preposition precedes it.] , (علينا) attached to (شهدتم) , (الذي) relative noun in the position of the nominative, adjective (naʿt) of the divine name (أوّل) mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, so it is its adjective (إليه) attached to (ترجعون) and the (الواو) in it is the deputy agent.
And the clause: «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the earlier resumption, namely the clause حتّى إذا ...
And the clause: «شهدتم..» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause: «قالوا ... (the second)» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
And the clause: «أنطقنا الله ... » is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause: «أنطق ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي) .
And the clause: «هو خلقكم ... » is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause أنطقنا الله [Note: it is possible that this too is from the speech of Allah the Exalted or from the speech of the angels, in which case the clause is resumptive.] .
And the clause: «خلقكم ... » is in the position of the nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هو) .
And the clause: «ترجعون..» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause خلقكم [Note: it is possible that it is conjoined to the nominal clause هو خلقكم if that is made resumptive,] .
(22) (الواو) resumptive [Note: and it is possible that it is conjoined to the ṣila clause, with what is between them parenthetical, because the speech that follows is the speech of Allah the Exalted, not the speech of the skins.] , (ما) negative (عليكم) attached to (يشهد) , (الواو) conjunction in the three places (لا) redundant, to emphasize the negation, in both places.
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن يشهد ... ) is in the position of the accusative as mafʿūl li-ajlihi, with an omitted muḍāf, that is "for fear that ... should bear witness" [Note: or in the position of the genitive by an omitted preposition, that is: "from [bearing witness] ..", attached to (تستترون) .] .
(لكن) for rectification (istidrāk), with no effect (لا) negative (ممّا) attached to an adjective of (كثيرا) [Note: (ما) is a maṣdar-forming particle, or a relative noun with the returning pronoun omitted.] .
And the clause: «ما كنتم تستترون..» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «تستترون..» is in the position of the accusative, khabar of كنتم.
And the clause: «يشهد عليكم سمعكم..» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle (أن) .
And the clause: «ظننتم ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ما كنتم ...
And the clause: «لا يعلم..» is in the position of the nominative, khabar of أنّ.
And the interpreted maṣdar (أنّ الله لا يعلم..) is in the position of the accusative, filling the place of the two objects of ظننتم.
And the clause: «تعملون ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle or relative noun.
(23) (الواو) conjunction (ظنّكم) badal (substitute) of the demonstrative [Note: or it is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ذلكم) , and the relative noun is a substitute for ظنّكم - or an explicative apposition to it - and the clause أرداكم is a ḥāl.. and it is permissible that (ظنّكم) , the relative noun, and the clause أرداكم be successive predicates.] , (الذي) relative noun in the position of the nominative, adjective (naʿt) of ظنّكم (بربّكم) it is in the place of the second object, that is "you thought Him to be of your Lord" (ظننتموه كائنا بربّكم) (الفاء) conjunction (من الخاسرين) attached to an omitted element, the khabar of أصبحتم.
And the clause: «ذلكم ظنّكم ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لكن ظننتم.
And the clause: «ظننتم بربّكم ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي) .
And the clause: «أرداكم ... » is in the position of the nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ذلكم) .
And the clause: «أصبحتم من الخاسرين» is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause أرداكم.
(24) (الفاء) conjunction, and the second is connective for the apodosis (لهم) attached to an adjective of مثوى (الواو) conjunction (الفاء) connective (ما) negative, working or not working (من المعتبين) attached to an omitted khabar.
And the clause: «إن يصبروا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ذلكم ظنّكم.
And the clause: «النار مثوى ... » is in the position of the jussive, apodosis joined with the فاء.
And the clause: «إن يستعتبوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يصبروا..
And the clause: «ما هم من المعتبين» is in the position of the jussive, apodosis joined with the فاء.
(25) (الواو) conjunction in the three places (لهم) attached to (قيّضنا) [Note: or to an omitted ḥāl from قرناء.] , and the second to (زيّنوا) , (بين) adverbial, accusative, attached to an omitted element, the ṣila of ما, and the second (ما) is conjoined to the first (خلفهم) adverbial, accusative, attached to the ṣila of the second ما (عليهم) attached to (حقّ) , (في أمم) attached to a ḥāl from the pronoun in (عليهم) , (من قبلهم) attached to (خلت) , (من الجنّ) attached to a ḥāl from the agent of خلت ...
And the clause: «قيّضنا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يصبروا..
And the clause: «زيّنوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قيّضنا.
And the clause: «حقّ ... القول ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause زيّنوا..
And the clause: «قد خلت..» is in the position of the genitive, adjective (naʿt) of أمم.
And the clause: «إنّهم كانوا خاسرين ... » has no grammatical position, a giving of reason for their deserving the punishment.
And the clause: «كانوا خاسرين ... » is in the position of the nominative, khabar of إنّ.

* Morphology:
(أرداكم) , contains a weakening by substitution: its origin is أرديكم; the yāʾ had a vowel after a fatḥa, so it was changed to alif.
(المعتبين) , plural of المعتب, a passive participle of (أعتب), the quadriliteral; its wazn is مفعل, with ḍamma on the mīm and fatḥa on the ʿayn.

* Rhetoric:
Kināya (metonymy): in the saying of the Exalted «شَهِدَ عَلَيْهِمْ سَمْعُهُمْ وَأَبْصارُهُمْ وَجُلُودُهُمْ» .
It was said that what is meant by "skins" is the limbs. And it was said: it is a metonymy for the private parts.

safi-cedvel:26-26.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing (لهذا) attached to (تسمعوا) , (القرآن) badal of the demonstrative - or an explicative apposition to it - (الغوا) imperative, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn.. and the (الواو) is the agent (فيه) attached to (الغوا) .
Clause: «قال الذين ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «لا تسمعوا ... » is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause: «الغوا..» is in the position of the accusative, conjoined to the clause لا تسمعوا.
And the clause: «لعلّكم تغلبون ... » has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
And the clause: «تغلبون» is in the position of the nominative, khabar of لعلّ.

* Morphology:
(الغوا) , contains a weakening by deletion starting from the imperfect يلغون - with fatḥa on the ghayn and sukūn on the wāw - whose origin is يلغاون; two sukūns met, so the alif - the lām of the word - was dropped, and what precedes the wāw remained with fatḥa to indicate it, so it became يلغون, and the weakening continued in the imperative.. and its wazn in the imperative is افعوا with fatḥa on the ʿayn, and it is of the pattern فرح: لغي يلغى, when one speaks what has no benefit.

* Benefits:
1- لعلّ:
It is a particle that makes the noun accusative and the khabar nominative, and Banū ʿUqayl put the mubtadaʾ in the genitive with it, as in the saying of Kaʿb ibn Saʿd lamenting his brother: فقلت:
ادع أخرى وارفع الصوت جهرة ... لعلّ أبي المغوار منك قريب
(So I said: Call another time and raise your voice openly; perhaps Abū l-Mighwār is near you)
The lightened form of (لعلّ) is not established. And know that the genitive noun after لعل is in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ, as in the preceding verse, by treating لعل as a redundant preposition, as in our saying (بحسبك درهم) . And the khabar (قريب) in the preceding verse.
The maṣdar-forming (ما) can be attached to (لعل) , and restrains it from working, because its specificity ceases then, as evidenced by the saying of al-Farazdaq: أعد نظرا يا عبد قيس لعلما ... أضاءت لك النار الحمار المقيدا
(Look again, O ʿAbd Qays, perhaps the fire has lit up for you the hobbled donkey)
It was said: the first solecism heard in Basra was: «لعل لها عذر وأنت تلوم» (Perhaps she has an excuse while you blame). And لعلّ conveys hope (tarajjī), which means expecting the occurrence of what is wished for, and apprehension (ishfāq) at the occurrence of what is disliked, as in our saying (لعلي ناجح) (perhaps I will succeed) and (لعل الشرّ بعيد) (perhaps evil is far away). The meaning of hope occurs in the verse we are dealing with, the saying of the Exalted وَقالَ الَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا لا تَسْمَعُوا لِهذَا الْقُرْآنِ وَالْغَوْا فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَغْلِبُونَ. And most of the time it occurs in the Noble Qur'an in the sense of certainty and realization, as in the saying of the Exalted يا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُتِبَ عَلَيْكُمُ الصِّيامُ كَما كُتِبَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِنْ قَبْلِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَتَّقُونَ, so the meaning of لعلكم تتقون is that piety will certainly come to you because of fasting.
2- The difference between hope (tarajjī) and wish (tamannī):
Tarajjī: is awaiting the occurrence of something possible, such as: (لعل المسافر يقدم) (perhaps the traveller will arrive) (لعل صاحب الحق يعفو) (perhaps the one who is owed will pardon). As for tamannī: it is hoping for the occurrence of something impossible, as in the poet's saying:
ألا ليت الشباب يعود يوما ... فأخبره بما صنع المشيب
(Would that youth might return one day, so I could tell it what old age has done)

safi-cedvel:27-27.t:
* I'rab:
(الفاء) resumptive (اللام) the lām of an oath, for an implied oath (نذيقنّ) imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the nominative.. and the (النون) is the nūn of emphasis, and the agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being نحن (عذابا) second direct object, accusative (الواو) conjunction (لنجزينّهم) like لنذيقنّ (أسوأ) second direct object, accusative (الذي) relative noun, muḍāf ilayhi, with the returning pronoun omitted.
Clause: «نذيقنّ..» has no grammatical position, the answer to the implied oath.
And the clause: «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «لنجزينّهم ... » has no grammatical position, the answer to the second implied oath, and the implied oath clause is conjoined to the first implied oath clause, which is resumptive.
And the clause: «كانوا يعملون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي) .
And the clause «يعملون» is in the position of the accusative, khabar of كانوا.

safi-cedvel:28-28.t:
* I'rab:
(ذلك) mubtadaʾ, and the demonstrative refers to the punishment (جزاء) khabar, nominative (النار) khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هي [Note: and the clause is an explanatory resumption.. and it is permissible that it be a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is the clause لهم فيها دار الخلد, and the clause is also an explanatory resumption.. and it is permissible that it be a badal of جزاء, but this is open to question, since the badal takes the place of the thing substituted for, so the construction would be ذلك النار.] (لهم) attached to a fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (دار) , (فيها) attached to a ḥāl from the pronoun in (لهم) , (جزاء) mafʿūl muṭlaq of an omitted verb [Note: or a mafʿūl muṭlaq whose governor is the first جزاء.. and it is permissible that it be a maṣdar in the position of a ḥāl.] , (ما) maṣdar-forming particle (بآياتنا) attached to (يجحدون) .
And the interpreted maṣdar (ما كانوا ... ) is in the position of the genitive by the (الباء) , attached to the first جزاء, and the (الباء) denotes cause.
And the clause: «ذلك جزاء ... » has no grammatical position, a giving of reason - or an explanatory resumption - and the clause: «لهم فيها دار الخلد ... » has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
And the clause: «كانوا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle (ما) .
And the clause: «يجحدون» is in the position of the accusative, khabar of كانوا.

* Rhetoric:
Tajrīd (abstraction): in the saying of the Exalted «النَّارُ لَهُمْ فِيها دارُ الْخُلْدِ» .
That is, it is itself their abode, in that فِي is for tajrīd, as was said regarding the saying of the Exalted «لَقَدْ كانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أُسْوَةٌ حَسَنَةٌ» and the poet's saying:
وفي الله إن لم ينصفوا حكم عدل. (And in Allah, if they are not fair, is a just judge)
And tajrīd is that from a thing possessing an attribute another like it is extracted, as exaggeration of that attribute; so from the Fire another abode was extracted, which He called the abode of eternity.

safi-cedvel:29-29.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (ربّنا) vocative (munādā), a muḍāf from which the vocative particle is omitted, accusative (اللذين) relative noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the (ياء) , in the position of the accusative, second direct object (من الجنّ) attached to a ḥāl from the agent of (أضلانا) (نجعلهما) imperfect verb, jussive, the answer to a request, and the agent is نحن and (هما) is the direct object (تحت) adverbial, accusative, attached to an omitted element, the second direct object (اللام) for giving a reason (يكونا) imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the لام (من الأسفلين) attached to an omitted element, the khabar of يكون.
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن يكونا..) is in the position of the genitive, attached to (نجعلهما) .
And the clause: «قال الذين..» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «كفروا..» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause of the vocative and its answer ... is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause: «أرنا ... » has no grammatical position, the answer to the vocative.
And the clause: «أضلّانا..» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (اللذين) .
And the clause: «نجعلهما ... » has no grammatical position, the apodosis of an implied condition not joined with the فاء, that is "if you show us those two ... we shall place them ..".
And the clause: «يكونا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle.

safi-cedvel:30-32.t:
* I'rab:
(ربّنا) mubtadaʾ, its khabar being الله (عليهم) attached to (تتنزّل) , (أن) the lightened form of the heavy [أنّ] [Note: it is permissible that it be a maṣdar-forming particle governing the accusative, with the interpreted maṣdar genitive by an omitted preposition attached to (تتنزّل) , and (لا) may be a prohibitive with the verb after it jussive, or a negative with the verb after it accusative.. and it may be explicative, because the descending (tanazzul) has the meaning of saying without its letters, and (لا) is prohibitive.] , and its subject (ism) is an omitted pronoun of the matter (ḍamīr al-shaʾn) (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing, in both places (بالجنّة) attached to (أبشروا) , (التي) relative noun in the position of the genitive, adjective (naʿt) of الجنّة, with the returning pronoun omitted..
And the interpreted maṣdar (أن لا تخافوا..) is in the position of the genitive by an omitted (باء) , attached to (تتنزّل) .
Clause: «إنّ الذين قالوا ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
Clause: «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «ربّنا الله ... » is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause: «استقاموا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قالوا.
And the clause: «تتنزل عليهم الملائكة» is in the position of the nominative, khabar of إنّ.
And the clause: «لا تخافوا ... » is in the position of the nominative, khabar of the lightened (أن) [Note: or it has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle أن.. or explicative, and the clauses لا تحزنوا and أبشروا are conjoined to it and take its grammatical position.] .
And the clause: «لا تحزنوا ... » is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause لا تخافوا.
And the clause: «أبشروا ... » is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause لا تخافوا.
And the clause: «كنتم توعدون» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (التي) .
And the clause: «توعدون..» is in the position of the accusative, khabar of كنتم.
(31) (في الحياة) attached to (أولياؤكم) and likewise (في الآخرة) , (الواو) conjunction (لكم) attached to an omitted element, the fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ما) , (فيها) attached to the omitted khabar in both places [Note: or attached to a ḥāl from the pronoun in (لكم) , the governor in it being the "settling" (istiqrār).] .
And the clause: «نحن أولياؤكم ... » has no grammatical position, a giving of reason confirming what preceded.
And the clause: «لكم فيها ما تشتهي ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
And the clause: «لكم فيها ما تدّعون» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
And the clause: «تشتهي ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the first relative noun (ما) .
And the clause: «تدّعون ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative noun (ما) .
(32) (نزلا) ḥāl, accusative, from the omitted returning pronoun, that is "you ask for it as a hospitable provision" [Note: it is permissible that (نزلا) be a ḥāl from the agent of تدعون, taking it as a plural of نازل ("one who alights"), and (من غفور) attached to (تدعون) .] , (من غفور) attached to an adjective of (نزلا) [Note: or attached to (تدعون) .] .

* Benefits:
Uprightness (istiqāma):
The people of verification said: The perfection of a human being is that he know the truth for its own sake in order to act by it, and the head of certain knowledge is knowledge of Allah the Exalted, and to it the saying of the Exalted points: إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ , and the head of righteous deeds is that a person be upright in the middle, not inclining to either extreme of excess or neglect, so uprightness is in the matter of religion and tawḥīd (affirming Allah's oneness), and it is in righteous deeds. Abū Bakr al-Ṣiddīq, may Allah the Exalted be pleased with him, was asked about uprightness, and he said:
That you associate nothing with Allah. And ʿUmar ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, may Allah the Exalted be pleased with him, said: Uprightness is that you remain upright upon the command and the prohibition and do not dodge like the fox. And ʿUthmān, may Allah the Exalted be pleased with him, said: The meaning of استقاموا is: they were sincere in deed.
And ʿAlī, may Allah the Exalted be pleased with him, said: The meaning of استقاموا is: they performed the obligations,
and this is the saying of Ibn ʿAbbās. And it was said: They stayed upright upon the command of Allah, so they acted in obedience to Him and avoided disobeying Him. And it was said: They stayed upright upon the testimony that there is no god but Allah until they met Allah. And when al-Ḥasan recited this verse he would say: O Allah, You are our Lord, so grant us uprightness. And in the saying of the Exalted in this verse إِنَّ الَّذِينَ قالُوا رَبُّنَا اللَّهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقامُوا, these two sentences sum up the meaning of religion and Islam; they are two short sentences, but great in their meaning, and they have gathered the concept of religion, Islam and the heavenly messages and have drawn a complete and precise path for the conduct of the Muslim in his life. How great is the speech of Allah and how far-reaching its scope!

safi-cedvel:33-33.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (من) interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ, its khabar being أحسن (قولا) tamyīz, accusative (ممّن) attached to أحسن (إلى الله) attached to (دعا) , (الواو) conjunction - or circumstantial (ḥāliyya) - and the second is a conjunction (صالحا) direct object, accusative [Note: it may be a mafʿūl muṭlaq standing in for the maṣdar, with the direct object implied.] , (من المسلمين) attached to the khabar of إنّ.
Clause: «من أحسن..» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «دعا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (من) .
And the clause: «عمل ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause [Note: or in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl from the agent of دعا, with an implied قد.] .
And the clause: «قال ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
And the clause: «إنّني من المسلمين» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying.

safi-cedvel:34-35.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (لا) negative (الواو) conjunction (لا) redundant, to emphasize the negation [Note: it is permissible that it be an original element (mu'assisa), not a redundant emphatic one, that is, the good deeds in relation to one another, and likewise the evil deeds.] , (بالتي) attached to (ادفع) (الفاء) giving a reason (إذا) of surprise (fujāʾiyya) (الذي) mubtadaʾ (بينك) adverbial, accusative, attached to an omitted element, the fronted khabar (بينه) adverbial attached to what the first is attached to, so it is conjoined to it (عداوة) delayed mubtadaʾ, nominative.
Clause: «لا تستوي الحسنة..» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «ادفع..» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
And the clause: «هي أحسن..» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (التي) .
And the clause: «الذي بينك.. عداوة..» has no grammatical position, a giving of reason [Note: it is permissible that the clause be conjoined to an implied reason, that is: that is more effective in repelling it, and then lo, the one between whom and you ...] .
And the clause: «بينك وبينه عداوة..» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي) .
And the clause: «كأنّه وليّ ... » is in the position of the nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذي) .
(35) (الواو) conjunction in both places (ما) negative (إلّا) for restriction (الذين) relative noun in the position of the nominative, deputy agent, and likewise (ذو) ; and the clause: «ما يلقّاها ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا تستوي الحسنة [Note: or it is resumptive originally.] .
And the clause: «صبروا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «ما يلقّاها (the second)» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ما يلقّاها (the first).

safi-cedvel:37-38.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (من آياته) attached to the fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الليل) .. (لا) prohibitive, jussive-governing (للشمس) attached to (تسجدوا) , (الواو) conjunction (لا) redundant, to emphasize the negation (للقمر) attached to what للشمس is attached to, so it is conjoined to it (اسجدوا) imperative, indeclinable on the dropping of the (النون) .. and the (الواو) is the agent (لله) attached to (اسجدوا) , (الذي) relative noun in the position of the genitive, adjective (naʿt) of the divine name (كنتم) defective past verb (kāna), indeclinable in the position of the jussive, protasis (إيّاه) detached pronoun in the position of the accusative, direct object, its governor being تعبدون.
Clause: «من آياته الليل..» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «لا تسجدوا للشمس..» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption [Note: it is permissible that it be in the position of the accusative, the content of an implied saying, that is: "Say to them, O Muhammad: do not prostrate ..."] .
And the clause: «اسجدوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا تسجدوا للشمس.
And the clause: «خلقهنّ ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي) .
And the clause: «كنتم إيّاه تعبدون..» has no grammatical position, parenthetical.. and the apodosis of the condition is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, that is: "so prostrate to Him".
And the clause: «تعبدون ... » is in the position of the accusative, khabar of كنتم.
(38) (الفاء) resumptive (استكبروا) in the position of the jussive, protasis (الفاء) connective or giving a reason (عند) adverbial, accusative, attached to an omitted element, the ṣila of the relative noun الذين (له) attached to a ḥāl from the agent of يسبّحون [Note: or attached to (يسبّحون) by its being made to include the meaning "they pray".] , (بالليل) attached to (يسبّحون) , (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya) (لا) negative.
And the clause: «إن استكبروا ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive - or conjoined to the implied clause of saying, and the apodosis of the condition is implied, that is "if they are arrogant, leave them", or "do not be concerned about their disobedience".
And the clause: «الذين عند ربّك ... » has no grammatical position, a giving of reason for the implied apodosis [Note: or it is the apodosis of the condition, in the position of the jussive.] .
And the clause: «يسبّحون له ... » is in the position of the nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ الذين.
And the clause: «هم لا يسأمون..» is in the position of the accusative, ḥāl from the agent of يسبحون [Note: or in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the clause يسبّحون.] .
And the clause: «لا يسأمون» is in the position of the nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم) .

* Benefits:
- The verse of prostration:
It is sunna for the reciter of the Qur'an to perform the prostration of recitation whenever he passes a verse of prostration. If he is outside the prayer, he intends the prostration of recitation and says takbīr, then says takbīr a second time for the prostration, and prostrates once and gives salām after it. During the prayer, he goes down for the prostration intending in his heart the prostration of recitation; if he utters the intention, his prayer is invalidated; and he prostrates once and then returns to continue his prayer, and this prostration becomes obligatory upon the follower (maʾmūm) if his imam prostrates, because following the imam is obligatory. Whoever is outside the prayer and recites a verse of prostration without being in a state of ablution says: سبحان الله والحمد لله ولا إله إلا الله الله أكبر ولا حول ولا قوة إلا بالله العلي العظيم (four times). This prostration in this sūra is among the confirmed prostrations of recitation, and as for the place of prostration in it there are two sayings of the scholars, which are two views of the companions of al-Shāfiʿī. One of them: that it is at the saying of the Exalted إِنْ كُنْتُمْ إِيَّاهُ تَعْبُدُونَ, and this is the saying of Ibn Masʿūd and al-Ḥasan, and al-Rāfiʿī related it from Abū Ḥanīfa and Aḥmad, because the mention of prostration precedes it. The second, which is the sounder view among the companions of al-Shāfiʿī, and so al-Rāfiʿī reported it, is at the saying of the Exalted وَهُمْ لا يَسْأَمُونَ, and this is the saying of Ibn ʿAbbās, Ibn ʿUmar, Saʿīd ibn al-Musayyab and Qatāda, and al-Zamakhsharī related it from Abū Ḥanīfa, because the sentence is complete there according to him.

safi-cedvel:36-36.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) conjunction (إمّا) a jussive-governing conditional particle, and (ما) is redundant (ينزغنّك) imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of the jussive, protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the (النون) is for emphasis, and the (الكاف) is the direct object (من الشيطان) attached to a ḥāl from the agent (نزغ) (الفاء) connective for the apodosis (بالله) attached to (استعذ) , (هو) a pronoun borrowed for the position of the accusative to emphasize the ism of (إنّ) [Note: or it is a detached pronoun, a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is السميع, and the clause is the khabar of إنّ.. and it is permissible that it be a separation pronoun.] , (العليم) second khabar, nominative.
Clause: «ينزغنّك من الشيطان نزغ» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause لا تستوي الحسنة.
And the clause: «استعذ ... » is in the position of the jussive, apodosis joined with the فاء.
And the clause: «إنّه هو السميع..» has no grammatical position, a giving of reason.

* Morphology:
(نزغ) : a samāʿī (heard-from-the-Arabs) maṣdar of the triliteral verb نزغ, of the two patterns فتح and ضرب; its wazn is فعل (fatḥa then sukūn).. and (النزغ) is whispering, or corrupting, or urging to disobedience.

safi-cedvel:39-39.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (من آياته) attached to a fronted khabar..
And the interpreted maṣdar (أنّك ترى ... ) is in the position of the nominative, delayed mubtadaʾ ...
(خاشعة) ḥāl, accusative (الفاء) conjunction (عليها) attached to (أنزلنا) , (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis (على كلّ) attached to قدير.
Clause: «من آياته أنّك ترى ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «ترى ... » is in the position of the nominative, khabar of أنّ.
And the clause: «أنزلنا ... » is in the position of the genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «اهتزّت ... » has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «ربت..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause اهتزّت.
And the clause: «إنّ الذي أحياها ... » has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
And the clause: «أحياها ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذي) .
And the clause: «إنّه على كلّ شيء قدير» has no grammatical position, a giving of reason.

* Morphology:
(خاشعة) , feminine of خاشع, an active participle from (خشع) ; see verse (45) of Sūrat al-Baqara.
(ربت) , contains a weakening by deletion - after a weakening by substitution - for the verb (ربا) : its alif was changed from a wāw; its imperfect is يربو and the origin is ربو; the wāw had a vowel after a fatḥa and was changed to alif - weakening by substitution - then the silent tāʾ of the feminine was added, so two sukūns met and the alif was dropped - weakening by deletion - its wazn is فعت..

* Rhetoric:
Representational metaphor (istiʿāra tamthīliyya): in the saying of the Exalted «وَمِنْ آياتِهِ أَنَّكَ تَرَى الْأَرْضَ خاشِعَةً فَإِذا أَنْزَلْنا عَلَيْهَا الْماءَ اهْتَزَّتْ وَرَبَتْ» .
Here he likened the state of the barrenness of the earth and its emptiness of vegetation, then Allah the Exalted's giving it life with rain, and its turning from barrenness to fertility, and the growing of every delightful pair, to the state of a gloomy person, downcast, shabby in appearance, who is not noticed; then when something of the enjoyment of this world and its adornment reaches him, he indulges in kinds of finery and ornament, and swaggers in his walk with pride, shaking his sides in conceit and arrogance. So he omitted the thing likened, and used humility (khushūʿ) and stirring (ihtizāz) as an indication of its place.

* Benefits:
- Choosing the wording that suits the occasion:
In this verse comes the saying of the Exalted وَمِنْ آياتِهِ أَنَّكَ تَرَى الْأَرْضَ خاشِعَةً , and in another place the attribute (هامدة) (withered) occurs. These two attributes did not occur in vain, without arrangement and coordination. The attribute (خاشعة) came to suit the atmosphere of worship, because it came in a context speaking of the worship of Allah, Mighty and Majestic, and prostration to Him; as for the attribute (هامدة) , it came in an atmosphere speaking of death and stillness. From here comes the secret of choosing these two attributes, so as to suit the atmosphere of the verses and harmonize with the general atmosphere of the meaning. How wonderful is the speech of Allah, and how precise its meaning!

safi-cedvel:40-40.t:
* I'rab:
(في آياتنا) attached to (يلحدون) , (لا) negative (علينا) attached to (يخفون) , (الهمزة) for affirmative interrogation (istifhām taqrīrī) (الفاء) conjunction (من) relative noun, mubtadaʾ in the position of the nominative, and the deputy agent is a latent pronoun, its implied form being هو, and it is the returning pronoun (في النار) attached to (يلقى) , (خير) khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أم) conjunction equivalent to the hamza (من) relative noun in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the first (آمنا) ḥāl, accusative, from the agent of يأتي (يوم) adverb of time, accusative, attached to (يأتي) and the command (اعملوا) contains the meaning of threat (ما) relative noun in the position of the accusative, direct object, with the returning pronoun omitted, that is "whatever you wish to do" (ما) maṣdar-forming particle ...
And the interpreted maṣdar (ما تعملون..) is in the position of the genitive by the (الباء) , attached to بصير.
Clause: «إنّ الذين يلحدون ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «يلحدون ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «لا يخفون..» is in the position of the nominative, khabar of إنّ.
And the clause: «من يلقى ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
And the clause: «يلقى ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the first relative noun (من) .
And the clause: «يأتي..» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative noun (من) .
And the clause: «اعملوا ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «شئتم..» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (ما) .
And the clause: «إنّه ... بصير» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
And the clause: «تعملون..» has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the particle (ما) .

* Morphology:
(يخفون) , contains a weakening by deletion because of the meeting of two sukūns; its origin is يخفاون, the alif was dropped and what precedes it remained with fatḥa; its wazn is يفعون with fatḥa on the ʿayn.
(يلقي) , contains a weakening by substitution to suit the passive construction: the active is يلقي, and in the passive the letter before the yāʾ takes fatḥa, so [the yāʾ] was changed to alif.

safi-cedvel:41-42.t:
* I'rab:
(بالذكر) attached to (كفروا) , and the khabar of إنّ is omitted, its implied form being معذّبون or مهلكون ("they will be punished" or "destroyed") [Note: or it is mentioned, coming in the following verses, namely his saying: «أولئك ينادون..» or his saying:
«ما يقال لك،» with the link implied, that is: «ما يقال لك في شأنهم ... » or his saying: «لا يأتيه الباطل» with the link implied, that is "from them" ... etc.] , (لمّا) adverbial meaning "when", stripped of conditionality, attached to (كفروا) , (الواو) circumstantial (ḥāliyya) (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis.
Clause: «إنّ الذين ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «كفروا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «جاءهم ... » is in the position of the genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «إنّه لكتاب ... » is in the position of the accusative, ḥāl from الذكر [Note: it is permissible that it be resumptive, in which case it has no grammatical position.] .
(42) (لا) negative (من بين) attached to (يأتيه) , (الواو) conjunction (لا) redundant, to emphasize the negation (من خلفه) attached to what the first prepositional phrase is attached to, so it is conjoined to it (تنزيل) khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هو (من حكيم) attached to تنزيل (حميد) adjective (naʿt) of حكيم.
And the clause: «لا يأتيه الباطل ... » is in the position of the nominative, adjective (naʿt) of كتاب.
And the clause: « (هو) تنزيل ... » has no grammatical position, a giving of reason.

safi-cedvel:43-43.t:
* I'rab:
(ما) negative (لك) attached to (يقال) , (إلّا) for restriction (ما) relative noun in the position of the nominative, deputy agent [Note: with an omitted muḍāf, that is "like what was said".. and the speaker in that case is the disbelievers of Mecca,] of the passive verb يقال (قد) particle of certainty (للرسل) attached to (قيل) , and the deputy agent of the second verb is a latent pronoun referring to (ما) (من قبلك) attached to a ḥāl from الرسل (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis (ذو) khabar of إنّ, nominative, the sign of the nominative being the wāw, and the second is conjoined to the first, nominative ...
Clause: «ما يقال ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «قد قيل ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (ما) .
And the clause: «إنّ ربّك لذو ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive [Note: it is permissible that it be in the position of the nominative as a badal of the relative noun (ما) , and that is if the one speaking to the Prophet is Allah and not the disbelievers of Quraysh.] .

safi-cedvel:44-44.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (لو) a non-jussive conditional particle (قرآنا) second direct object, accusative (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of (لو) (لولا) particle of urging (الهمزة) for rhetorical-denying interrogation (istifhām inkārī) (أعجميّ) khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هو, that is the Qur'an [Note: or it is a mubtadaʾ and عربيّ is conjoined to it, and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being يستويان - or مستويان ("the two are equal")-] , (الواو) conjunction (عربيّ) khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being هو, that is the Prophet (للذين) attached to a ḥāl from هدى [Note: or attached to هدى..] , (الواو) resumptive (في آذانهم) attached to the fronted khabar of the delayed mubtadaʾ (وقر) (عليهم) attached to a ḥāl from (عمى) [Note: or attached to the maṣdar عمى by its being made to include the meaning of "darkness".] , and the (الواو) in (ينادون) is the deputy agent (من مكان) attached to (ينادون) .
Clause: «جعلناه ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «لولا فصّلت آياته ... » is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause: « (أهو) أعجميّ ... » has no grammatical position, a resumption within the scope of the saying.
And the clause: « (هو) عربيّ ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause هو أعجميّ.
And the clause: «قل ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «هو.. هدى» is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause: «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the first relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «لا يؤمنون ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the second relative noun (الذين) .
And the clause: «في آذانهم وقر ... » is in the position of the nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الذين لا يؤمنون) and the nominal clause composed of the mubtadaʾ and khabar has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «هو عليهم عمى ... » is in the position of the nominative, conjoined to the khabar clause, with the implied sense "in their ears is deafness and it is blindness for them".
And the clause: «أولئك ينادون..» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «ينادون:..» is in the position of the nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (أولئك) .

* Rhetoric:
1- Tashbīh baligh (eloquent simile): in the saying of the Exalted «قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا هُدىً وَشِفاءٌ» .
An eloquent simile: he made the Qur'an guidance itself and healing itself, guiding them to the paths of right conduct and healing them from the ailments of madness.
2- Representational metaphor (istiʿāra tamthīliyya): in the saying of the Exalted «يُنادَوْنَ مِنْ مَكانٍ بَعِيدٍ» .
A representation of them, in their not understanding and not benefiting from what they were called to, as one who is called from a distant place, so he hears the voice but does not understand its details or meanings; or he neither hears nor understands.

* Benefits:
An opinion and an objection:
Ibn Hishām set out the opinion of al-Zamakhsharī on this verse and replied to it, saying: (As for the saying of al-Zamakhsharī on the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic) قُلْ هُوَ لِلَّذِينَ آمَنُوا هُدىً وَشِفاءٌ وَالَّذِينَ لا يُؤْمِنُونَ فِي آذانِهِمْ وَقْرٌ , that its implied form may be هو في آذانهم وقر (it is in their ears deafness), so the mubtadaʾ was omitted, or في آذانهم من وقر (in their ears is some deafness), with the clause being the khabar of الذين, while it is possible that there is no omission in it: its reason is that when he saw that what comes before this clause and what comes after it is discourse about the Qur'an, he assumed what lies between them to be likewise; unless one were to suppose a conjunction of الذين upon الذين and of «وقر» upon «هدى», in which case a conjunction upon the objects of two governors would be necessary, and Sībawayh does not allow it, and on that basis (في آذانهم) would be an adjective of وقر that was fronted before it and so became a ḥāl.
