safi-cedvel:45-45.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) resumptive (اللام) the lām of an oath, for an implied oath (قد) particle of certainty (الكتاب) second direct object, accusative, (الفاء) conjunction (فيه) deputy agent of the passive (الواو) conjunction (لولا) a non-jussive conditional particle (كلمة) mubtadaʾ, nominative, and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being موجودة ("existing") (من ربّك) attached to a second adjective of كلمة (اللام) occurring in the apodosis of (لولا) (بينهم) adverbial, accusative, attached to (قضي) [Note: or an adverbial indeclinable on the fatḥa in the position of the nominative, deputy agent.] and the deputy agent is omitted, being the maṣdar of the verb قضي, that is "the decree was decreed" (الواو) resumptive (اللام) the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis (في شك) attached to the khabar of إنّ (منه) attached to an adjective of شكّ (مريب) adjective of شكّ, genitive like it.
Clause: «لقد آتينا ... » has no grammatical position, the answer to the implied oath, and the implied oath clause has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «اختلف فيه..» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause of the answer to the oath.
And the clause: «لولا كلمة ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause of the answer to the oath.
And the clause: «سبقت..» is in the position of the nominative, adjective (naʿt) of كلمة.
And the clause: «قضي بينهم ... » has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «إنّهم لفي شكّ ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.

safi-cedvel:46-46.t:
* I'rab:
(من) a jussive-governing conditional noun, indeclinable, in the position of the nominative, mubtadaʾ (عمل) in the position of the jussive, protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) (الفاء) connective for the apodosis (لنفسه) attached to a khabar, and the mubtadaʾ is omitted, its implied form being عمله ("his deed") (الواو) conjunction (من أساء) like من عمل (فعليها) like فلنفسه [Note: and the pronoun in (عليها) refers to النفس, and the implied mubtadaʾ is إساءته ("his wrongdoing") or ضرر إساءته ("the harm of his wrongdoing").] , (الواو) resumptive (ما) negative, working as ليس does (ظلّام) genitive in form, accusative in position, khabar of ما (للعبيد) attached to ظلّام [Note: it is permissible that the lām be redundant, for reinforcement, and (العبيد) the object of ظلّام.
(3, 4) It is permissible that the khabar be the two clauses of protasis and apodosis together.] .
Clause: «من عمل صالحا ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «عمل صالحا ... » is in the position of the nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «3» .
And the clause: « (عمله) لنفسه ... » is in the position of the jussive, apodosis joined with the فاء.
And the clause: «من أساء ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause.
And the clause: «أساء ... » is in the position of the nominative, khabar of the mubtadaʾ (من) «4» .
And the clause: « (إساءته) عليها» is in the position of the jussive, apodosis joined with the فاء.
And the clause: «ما ربّك بظلّام» has no grammatical position, resumptive.

safi-cedvel:47-48.t:
* I'rab:
(إليه) attached to the passive (يردّ) , (الواو) conjunction in the four places (ما) negative (ثمرات) genitive in form, nominative in position, agent of تخرج (من أكمامها) attached to (تخرج) , (ما تحمل من أنثى) like ما تخرج من ثمرات (لا) for negation (إلّا) for restriction (بعلمه) attached to (تضع) , (يوم) direct object of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر [Note: or an adverb of time, accusative, attached to (قالوا) ..] (أين) interrogative noun in the position of the accusative, as an adverb of place, attached to the fronted khabar of the mubtadaʾ (شركائي) (ما) negative (منّا) attached to a fronted khabar (شهيد) genitive in form, nominative in position, delayed mubtadaʾ.
Clause: «إليه يردّ علم ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «ما تخرج من ثمرات ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause [Note: or resumptive.] And the clause: «ما تحمل من أنثى ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ما تخرج ...
And the clause: «لا تضع ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ما تحمل ...
And the clause: « (اذكر) يوم ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive clause And the clause: «يناديهم ... » is in the position of the genitive, muḍāf ilayhi.
And the clause: «أين شركائي ... » is in the position of the accusative, the content of an implied saying [Note: or it has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.] And the clause: «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive And the clause: «آذنّاك ... » is in the position of the accusative, the content of the saying And the clause: «ما منّا من شهيد» has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption [Note: some make it fill the place of the second and third objects of the verb آذناك, so that it means أعلمناك ("we informed you"), but the verbs that take three objects do not include آذن ... In Lisān al-ʿArab it says: آذنه بالشيء: أعلمه ("he notified him of the thing: he informed him").] 48- (الواو) conjunction (عنهم) attached to (ضلّ) by its being made to include the meaning "was absent" (ما) relative noun - or an indefinite noun that is qualified - agent (قبل) adverbial noun, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the genitive, attached to (يدعون) , (الواو) conjunction (ما لهم من محيص) like ما منّا من شهيد.
And the clause: «ضلّ عنهم ما ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قالوا And the clause: «كانوا يدعون ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila of the relative noun (ما) [Note: or in the position of the nominative, an adjective of (ما) , taking it as an indefinite noun that is qualified.] And the clause: «يدعون ... » is in the position of the accusative, khabar of كانوا And the clause: «ظنّوا ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause ضلّ ...
And the clause: «ما لهم من محيص» is in the position of the accusative, filling the place of the two objects of ظنّ, which is suspended by the negation ما.

* Morphology:
(أكمامها) , plural of كمّ or كمّة, a name for the covering of the fruit; the wazn of كمّ is فعل (kasra then sukūn), and the wazn of كمّة is فعلة (ḍamma then sukūn), and in both the ʿayn and the lām come from a single letter ... And كمّ is also pluralized as أكمّه on the pattern أفعله like أفئدة, and as كمام on the pattern فعال with kasra on the fāʾ, and as أكاميم on the pattern أفاعيل.

* Benefits:
- None knows the unseen except Allah:
This verse made clear that the Day of Resurrection is known only to Allah, Mighty and Majestic, for the Exalted said يَسْئَلُونَكَ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْساها فِيمَ أَنْتَ مِنْ ذِكْراها. إِلى رَبِّكَ مُنْتَهاها and the Exalted said لا يُجَلِّيها لِوَقْتِها إِلَّا هُوَ. And when
Jibrīl asked the Messenger of Allah ﷺ about the Hour, he said to him: (ما المسؤول عنها بأعلم من السائل) (The one asked about it knows no more than the one asking).
Therefore any claim that professes knowledge of the Hour or the like of knowledge of the unseen is invalid, and thereby what the soothsayers and astrologers say is invalid, for it is only delusion, conjecture and fabrication.
He ﷺ said: Whoever comes to a soothsayer and believes him has disbelieved in what was sent down to Muḥammad,
because knowledge of the unseen is particular to Allah, so if a person believes the saying of an astrologer he has associated partners with Allah, Mighty and Majestic.

safi-cedvel:1-5.t:
* I'rab:
(تنزيل) is a mubtadaʾ, nominative, its khabar being كتاب [Note: what made it permissible to begin with an indefinite noun is its being described by the prepositional phrase.. and it is permissible that the word be a khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "this Qur'an".]. (من الرحمن) is attached to an adjective of (تنزيل). (الرحيم) is an adjective of الرحمن, genitive.
The clause «تنزيل ... » has no grammatical position; inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya)..
(3) (قرآنا) is a ḥāl from آيات, accusative [Note: or a ḥāl from كتاب because it is described.]. (لقوم) is attached to (فصّلت).
And the clause «فصّلت آياته ... » is in the position of nominative, an adjective of كتاب.
And the clause «يعلمون» is in the position of genitive, an adjective of قوم.
(4) (بشيرا) is a second adjective of (قرآنا), accusative [Note: or a ḥāl from كتاب or from آياته.]. (الفاء) is a conjunction in the two places. (لا) is negative.
And the clause «أعرض أكثرهم..» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the inceptive clause..
And the clause «هم لا يسمعون» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause أعرض أكثرهم.
And the clause «لا يسمعون» is in the position of nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (هم).
(5) (الواو) is a conjunction in the four places. (في أكنّة) is attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ قلوبنا. (ممّا) is attached to أكنّة, on the assumption of "veiled". (إليه) is attached to (تدعونا). (في (آذاننا) is attached to a fronted khabar for the mubtadaʾ وقر. (من بيننا) is a fronted khabar for the mubtadaʾ حجاب. (الفاء) is the connective of an implied condition ...
And the clause «قالوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause أعرض أكثرهم.
And the clause «قلوبنا في أكنّة ... » is in the position of accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause «تدعونا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (ما).
And the clause «في آذاننا وقر ... » is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause of the content of the saying.
And the clause «من بيننا.. حجاب» is in the position of accusative, conjoined to the clause of the content of the saying.
And the clause «اعمل» is in the position of jussive, the apodosis of an implied condition, i.e. "if you wish to continue the call, then act".
And the clause «إنّنا عاملون» has no grammatical position; explanatory of cause (taʿlīliyya) — or an explanatory resumption.

* Rhetoric:
Representational metaphor (al-istiʿāra al-tamthīliyya): in the words of the Exalted «وَقالُوا قُلُوبُنا فِي أَكِنَّةٍ» up to His words «عامِلُونَ». In the verse there are three representational metaphors, for their hearts' recoiling from perceiving the truth and accepting it, their ears' spitting it out, and their refusal to join and agree with the Messenger ﷺ. By that they intended to make him despair, upon him be blessings and peace, of their following him, so that he would not call them to the straight path.
Al-Zamakhsharī mentioned in his book al-Kashshāf that in this verse there is such emphasis and eloquence as is fit to be strung only among the pearls of the Mighty Book, for it includes the mention of three successive veils, each one of them sufficient in its own art: the first is the veil that intervenes from outside, followed by the veil of deafness, and the farthest is the veil that has enclosed the heart — we seek refuge in Allah. This verse left no hanging veil without letting it down, and left these wretched ones no hope or cry for help without stripping it away.

safi-cedvel:6-7.t:
* I'rab:
(إنّما) is a restrictive particle and the restricted (kāffa and makfūfa). (مثلكم) is an adjective of بشر, nominative. (إليّ) is attached to (يوحى). (أنّما) is a restrictive particle and the restricted..
And the interpreted maṣdar (أنّما إلهكم إله ... ) is in the position of nominative, the deputy agent.
(الفاء) is a conjunction [Note: there may be in it the meaning of causality, so it conjoins the clause after it to the clause of the content of the saying.]. (إليه) is attached to (استقيموا), by making it include the meaning of "turn". (الواو) is resumptive. (ويل) is a mubtadaʾ, nominative [Note: beginning with it is sound because it indicates censure.]. (للمشركين) is attached to the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ويل.
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause «أنا بشر ... » is in the position of accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause «يوحى ... » is in the position of nominative, a second adjective of بشر.
And the clause «استقيموا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause قل [Note: it is the like of his saying, upon him be peace: «قل لا إله إلّا الله ثمّ استقم».].
And the clause «استغفروه ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause قل.
And the clause «ويل للمشركين» has no grammatical position; resumptive.
(7) (الذين) is an adjective of المشركين, in the position of genitive [Note: or a khabar of an obligatorily omitted mubtadaʾ, its implied form being "هم".]. (لا) is negative. (الواو) is a conjunction in the two places. (هم) the second is an emphasis (tawkīd) of the first.
And the clause «لا يؤتون..» has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
And the clause «هم ... كافرون» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause of the ṣila.

safi-cedvel:8-8.t:
* I'rab:
(لهم) is attached to a fronted khabar for the mubtadaʾ (أجر). (غير) is an adjective of أجر, nominative..
The clause «إنّ الذين آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause «آمنوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is the ṣila of the relative (الذين).
And the clause «عملوا ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause آمنوا ...
And the clause «لهم أجر ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of inna.

* Morphology:
(ممنون): a passive participle from the triliteral verb منّ in the sense of "to cut", of the Naṣara bāb; its wazn is مفعول.

safi-cedvel:9-12.t:
* I'rab:
(الهمزة) is for an interrogation of denial. (اللام) is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis. (بالذي) is attached to (تكفرون). (في يومين) is attached to (خلق). (له) is attached to an omitted second direct object..
The clause «قل ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause «إنّكم لتكفرون..» is in the position of accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause «تكفرون ... » is in the position of nominative, the khabar of inna.
And the clause «تكفرون ... » is in the position [Translator's note: the source reads "في محلّ لها" ("in the position of it"), evidently missing "لا" so that it should read "has no position"] of ... the ṣila of the relative (الذي).
And the clause «تجعلون ... » is in the position of nominative, conjoined to the clause تكفرون..
And the clause «ذلك ربّ....» has no grammatical position; an explanatory resumption.
(10) (الواو) is a conjunction. (فيها) is attached to (جعل), by making it include the meaning of "created" [Note: or attached to an omitted second direct object.]. (من فوقها) is attached to an adjective of رواسي. (فيها) is attached to (بارك), and the third is attached to (قدّر). (في أربعة) is attached to (قدّر), with an omitted muḍāf, i.e. "in the completion of four". (سواء) is an absolute object of an omitted verb [Note: or a maṣdar in the position of ḥāl from أقواتها.]. (للسائلين) is attached to the omitted verb.
And the clause «جعل ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause خلق.
And the clause «بارك..» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause خلق.
And the clause «قدّر ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause خلق.
(11) (ثمّ) is a conjunction. (إلى السماء) is attached to (استوى), by making it include the meaning of "He directed Himself". (الواو) is circumstantial (ḥāliyya). (الفاء) is a conjunction. (لها، للأرض) are both attached to (قال), conjoined to each other. (طوعا) is a maṣdar in the position of ḥāl. (طائعين) is an accusative ḥāl from the agent of أتينا.
And the clause «استوى ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause قدّر.
And the clause «هي دخان ... » is in the position of accusative, a ḥāl.
And the clause «قال ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause استوى.
And the clause «ائتيا ... » is in the position of accusative, the content of the saying.
And the clause «قالتا ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.
And the clause «أتينا ... » is in the position of accusative, the content of the saying.
(12) (الفاء) is a conjunction. (سبع) is a second direct object, its governor being قضاهنّ by making it include the meaning of "He made them" [Note: or a ḥāl from the hāʾ in (قضاهنّ) in the sense of "He fashioned them".], accusative. (في يومين) is attached to (قضاهنّ). (الواو) is a conjunction in the three places. (في كلّ) is attached to (أوحى). (بمصابيح) is attached to (زيّنا). (حفظا) is an absolute object of an omitted verb, and the indication in (ذلك) is to what has been mentioned before. (العليم) is an adjective of العزيز, genitive.
And the clause «قضاهنّ..» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause قال by a link of causality, or by a link of explanation.
And the clause «أوحى ... » has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause قضاهنّ.
And the clause «زيّنا..» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause أوحى, taking account of the shift of person in it.
And the clause « (حفظناها) حفظا» has no grammatical position; it is conjoined to the clause زيّنا ...
And the clause «ذلك تقدير ... » has no grammatical position; resumptive.

* Morphology:
(10) أقواتها: plural of قوت, a noun for food; its wazn is فعل with ḍamma then sukūn, and the wazn of أقوات is أفعال.
(11) دخان: a noun for condensed water vapour or other; its wazn is فعال with ḍamma on the fāʾ.
(طائعين): plural of طائع — it came masculine by predominance — an active participle from the triliteral verb طاع, of the Bāʿa bāb; its wazn is فاعل, and in it the ʿayn of the word — which is the yāʾ — is replaced by a hamza by analogy with every active participle that comes from a hollow verb (muʿtall ajwaf).. its origin is طايع.

* Rhetoric:
1- The formal intensive simile (al-tashbīh al-baligh al-ṣūrī): in the words of the Exalted «ثُمَّ اسْتَوى إِلَى السَّماءِ وَهِيَ دُخانٌ».
It is a formal intensive simile, because its form is the form of smoke in the eye's view; and what is meant by smoke is the vapour from which the layers of air are formed, so there is no conflict with the most recent theories of science.
2- Representation (al-tamthīl): in the words of the Exalted «فَقالَ لَها وَلِلْأَرْضِ ائْتِيا طَوْعاً أَوْ كَرْهاً قالَتا أَتَيْنا طائِعِينَ». The meaning of the command to the heaven and the earth to come and their compliance is that He willed to bring them into being, and they did not refuse Him, and they came into existence as He willed, and they were in that like one commanded who obeys when the act of the commander who is obeyed reaches him. This is a type of figurative speech (majāz) called representation (tamthīl). It is also permissible that it be an imaginative depiction (takhyīl), the matter in it being built on the view that Allah the Exalted spoke to the heaven and the earth and said to them: "Come, whether you wish it or refuse it", and they said: "We have come willingly, not unwillingly." The aim is only to portray the effect of His power in the things within His power, without any speech or answer actually taking place. The like of it is the saying of the speaker: "The wall said to the peg: 'Why do you split me?' The peg said: 'Ask the one who hammers me, and who did not leave me, with the stone behind me.'"
3- Iltifāt (shift of person): in the words of the Exalted «وَزَيَّنَّا السَّماءَ الدُّنْيا بِمَصابِيحَ».
A shift from the third person to the first person, for the adornment is ascribed to His own Self, Glorified is He, to bring out a greater care for the matter.
